# Investment Memorandum

## 1. Executive Summary

- On September 30, 2020, Bank of Montreal as Administrative Agent granted a Fourth Amended and Restated Limited Waiver to MGE Niagara Entertainment Inc. (a casino operator) extending various covenant waivers until November 30, 2020.
- MGE Niagara Entertainment Inc. serves as the Borrower, with Complex Services Inc. as guarantor, under a credit agreement originally dated June 10, 2019 and amended July 17, 2019.
- This waiver addresses covenant breaches and operational defaults resulting from COVID-19 mandated casino closures. The Ontario Lottery and Gaming Corporation (OLG) authorized temporary closure of Casino Facilities due to the pandemic.
- The purpose is to provide temporary relief from financial covenant breaches (Sections 9.4.1 and 9.4.2), closure-related defaults (Section 11.1.11), and compliance certificate delivery requirements during the Extended Waiver Period through November 30, 2020.
- MGE Niagara Entertainment Inc. operates casino facilities under agreements with OLG. The company has experienced significant operational disruption due to government-mandated closures lasting more than 60 consecutive days.

## 2. Investment Highlights & Risks

### Key Strengths / Credit Positives:
- OLG (Ontario Lottery and Gaming Corporation) has provided financial relief including full relief from threshold payments and continued Fixed Component Per Diem payments during closure
- Bank of Montreal leads the lending syndicate, indicating institutional lender support
- Borrower maintains compliance representations and warranties after giving effect to waivers

### Principal Risks and Mitigating Factors:
- Extended casino closure period (>60 consecutive days) creating operational and financial stress
- Financial covenant breaches in Sections 9.4.1 and 9.4.2 indicating deteriorated credit metrics
- Borrower restricted from requesting new advances under either credit facility during waiver period
- Pricing moved to Level 5 (highest cost tier) with 5.00% margin on Bankers' Acceptances/LIBOR loans
- Risk mitigated by OLG support payments and minimum liquidity covenant of $15,000,000
